title: Enforce immutable exact primitive types in AnnounceMessage
description: P3 security/robustness: frozen AnnounceMessage validates only len/ranges, so bool sequences/channels, str values of matching length, and mutable bytearray/memoryview identity, signature, or app_data can pass construction (including from_bytes on non-bytes input) and later fail inconsistently or mutate after a trust check. Enforce exact int (not bool) and immutable bytes for every wire/security field, bound app data to the link-profile maximum, and add constructor/parser mutation/type tests.
